  {
    mem_set := fun s => p sᶜ,
    univ_mem := by unfold mem_set; apply he,
    inter_mem_of_mem_left := by intros s t hs ht; unfold mem_set; apply hmono t hs _,
    inter_mem_of_mem_right := by intros s t hs ht; unfold mem_set; apply hmono s hs _,
    union_mem_of_mem_left := by intros s t hs ht; unfold mem_set; apply hunion s hs t ht,
    union_mem_of_mem_right := by intros s t hs ht; unfold mem_set; apply hunion t ht s hs,
    mono := by intros s t hst hsht; unfold mem_set; apply hmono s hsht _,
    eq_univ_of_is_empty_compl := by unfold mem_set; intro h; unfold compl; exact absurd h (ne_empty _)
  }
